caption:
Tradies miss calls on the tools. Every missed call is a missed job. 📞

The side hustle: build an AI receptionist that answers 24/7 and books jobs.
1. Pick one niche: tradies, dentists, salons, mechanics
2. Collect their hours, services and FAQs
3. Build it in Vapi or Retell
4. Demo it with THEIR business details
5. Free trial, then setup fee + monthly

Tell callers it's an AI and check call-recording rules.

Found in my own saved reels and sorted by SaveSort. Sort yours free, link in bio.
